priorAttempt.detail: The /v2/analyze request never reached uvicorn (server log showed only the earlier GET /health) -- a client-side network failure, not a 4xx/5xx. Moments later the harness reaped every background process this task depended on (server, demo pages, cross-origin pages, NER) for critical system memory; a pre-existing, not-mine qwen2.5:1.5b Ollama load was also present at the time. Most likely a resource-exhaustion casualty, not a defect in agent-loop-v2.js/background.js/server/main.py -- stated as the likely explanation, not confirmed.
